scope_rules.district_scope_description: Special election to fill a vacancy in Congressional District 14.
scope_rules.office_or_measure_label: United States House of Representatives, District 14
scope_rules.plain_language: If you are a registered voter living in the covered district territory by the registration deadline, you may vote in this special election. Check the covered territory description before relying on a countywide answer.

scope_rules.district_scope_description: Runoff primary using the same party-specific ballot universe as the earlier primary.
scope_rules.party_carry_forward_rule: A voter who voted in one party's primary may vote only in that party's runoff during the same calendar year.
scope_rules.plain_language: A qualified voter does not have to have voted in the initial primary to vote in the runoff, but a voter who already affiliated with a party by voting in that party's primary may not switch to another party's runoff in the same year.
